# The Art of Living Foundation Canada

> Non-profit teaching meditation, breathwork (SKY Breath Meditation / Sudarshan Kriya) and yoga across Canada, in person and online, in English and French.

Contact: +1-800-983-3886. Head office and retreat centre: 13 Chem. de l'Infinité, Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc, QC.

## Programs
- [Art of Living Part 1](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/art-of-living-part-one): Breath and meditation course built around SKY / Sudarshan Kriya, a rhythmic breathing technique, with guided meditation and practical wisdom for daily stress. (First Steps)
- [Sahaj Samadhi Meditation](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sahaj-samadhi-meditation): Mantra-based meditation, given personally to each participant, for effortless daily practice. (First Steps)
- [Art of Living Part 2](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/art-of-living-part-two): Silence retreat with deeper meditations, mudras and pranayamas, for people who have done Part 1. (First Steps)
- [Deep Sleep & Anxiety Relief](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/deep-sleep-and-anxiety): Short protocol of breathing and relaxation practices aimed at better sleep and relief from anxiety. (Entry Level)
- [Introductory Workshop](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/intro-talk): Introductory session to experience a breathing technique and guided meditation before taking a full course. (Entry Level)
- [Sri Sri Yoga](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sri-sri-yoga): Yoga course combining postures, breathing and meditation. (Entry Level)
- [Intuition Process](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/intuition-process): Program for children and teens to develop intuition. (Entry Level)
- [SKY Kids (ART Excel)](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/art-excel): Breathing and life-skills program for children. (Entry Level)
- [SKY Teens (YES! program)](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/youth-empowerment-seminar-yes): Youth Empowerment Seminar with breathing techniques and life skills for teens. (Entry Level)
- [SKY Campus (university and college)](https://skycampuscanada.org/): SKY breathing and meditation program run for university and college students. (Entry Level)
- [Sudarshan Kriya Follow-ups](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sudarshan-kriya-follow-ups): Group follow-up sessions to practise Sudarshan Kriya together after Part 1. (Graduate)
- [Sanyam](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sanyam): Advanced meditation retreat. (Graduate)
- [Shakti Kriya](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/shakti-kriya): Advanced breathing program. (Graduate)
- [Blessings Program](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/blessings-program): Advanced program for graduates. (Graduate)
- [Volunteer Training Program](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/volunteer-training-program): Training for people who want to volunteer and lead in their community. (Graduate)

## Centres
- [Art of Living Toronto Downtown](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/toronto-downtown): Toronto, ON
- [Art of Living Toronto Etobicoke](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/toronto-etobicoke): Toronto, ON
- [Art of Living Richmond Hill](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/richmond-hill): Richmond Hill, ON
- [Art of Living North Vancouver](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/north-vancouver): Vancouver, BC
- [Art of Living Canada Centre (retreat)](https://www.artoflivingcanadacentre.org/): Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc, QC
- [Art of Living Kitchener-Waterloo](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/center/kitchener-waterloo): Kitchener-Waterloo, ON
- [Art of Living Markham](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/center/markham): Markham, ON
- [Art of Living Sherbrooke](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/center/sherbrooke): Sherbrooke, QC
- [Art of Living Montreal - Lachine](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/montreal-lachine): Montreal, QC
- [Art of Living Vancouver Region](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/center/vancouver-region): Vancouver, BC
